capabilities: Render notes and images as a masonry gallery via a code block
Filter and search notes using Obsidian search syntax queries
Sort, limit and recursively scan folders
Cache markdown card loading for fast previews
disambiguation: Despite the name, it is not an image-gallery viewer only; it renders whole notes as cards via a code block in a note.
extras: Early alpha; installable via BRAT for beta testing; README reports testing with a couple thousand notes.
problem: Obsidian shows notes only as lists in the file explorer, with no visual grid or preview-style browsing of folders and search results.
summary: Masonry-style gallery that renders notes and images from a folder or query as visual cards inside a code block.
